public.title: Sort Colors
public.description: Return the values sorted in ascending order. Each value is 0, 1, or 2. There are 0 to 1000 values. Return the resulting array; mutation is optional. Aim for linear time.
hints: Count the occurrences of each of the three possible values.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Three counters followed by ordered expansion take O(n) time and O(n) output space.
